heroblade.release_notes:
## TUG Engine — 64-bit editor with the new renderer

Covers work landed between February and September 2026.

### The editor is now 64-bit
- LaniBlade.exe, heblade.dll and every engine plugin are built as x64 (ReleaseHB|x64). The 32-bit 2 GB address ceiling is gone; large worlds and long editing sessions no longer run out of memory.
- 64-bit runtimes ship with the editor: PhysX 2.8.4.6 (PhysXCore64, PhysXLoader64, PhysXCooking64, NxCharacter64, PhysXDevice64, cudart64), FMOD Ex / FMOD Event / FMOD Studio x64, OpenSSL 3 (libcrypto-3-x64, libssl-3-x64).
- The release pipeline was rebuilt for x64. HEDiligent.dll is now a required, shipped and signed part of the package; every engine binary is Authenticode-signed, and all PDBs go to Sentry for symbolicated crash reports.

### New renderer: Diligent (Direct3D 11 / Direct3D 12 / Vulkan)
- HEDiligent.dll is the default renderer. Direct3D 9 (HEDirect3D9) and OpenGL (HEOpenGL21) remain available as fallbacks. The backend can be chosen with HE_DILIGENT_BACKEND; the status bar shows the live backend and GPU adapter.
- The Direct3D 9 visual-parity programme is closed. Ported and verified against the old renderer: terrain (bump, specular, sRGB sampling, heightmap lighting), water (reflections, ocean colour ops, grazing-angle fix), GPU-skinned characters with per-pixel lighting, static meshes, omni/spot local lights, directional and blob shadows with hardware PCF (high-quality shadows on by default), HDR post-processing (tonemap, bloom, star), MSAA, distance fog, sky dome and clouds, particles, vegetation cut-outs (leaf shimmer fixed), armour tint and craft shininess, the vortex effect, and rain (density, per-drop phase, eye-facing streaks).
- Performance: open-world frame time cut from 36.75 ms to 12.00 ms; dynamic vertex buffers append instead of discarding per draw; the Vulkan open-world lock-up is fixed and its dynamic heap tuned; the D3D12 descriptor heap is sized from measurement.
- Diagnostics: an in-editor HUD with measured GPU time, a per-process Diligent diagnostics log, and D3D9/Diligent per-draw state tracers for renderer comparison.
- HeSGSceneMOC scene plugin: GPU occlusion-query hybrid culling, frustum-first early reject, loose-octree spatial partitioning and an optimised GPU query pipeline.
- System Options: the anti-aliasing and anisotropic filtering switches now take effect.

### HSE2 script editor
- New Agent panel (Claude or Codex) inside HSE2: it writes HSL, drives the DOM Editor, reads the running world's nodes and console, accepts pasted screenshots, supports slash commands, keeps conversation history with arrow-key recall, compacts automatically, shows exactly what it changed, stamps an audit header on every script it writes and leaves a real commit comment.
- Collaboration: see who else has a script open, watch a peer's typing live, and get a notification when someone publishes. The editor shows the name a developer signs in with.
- Large scripts can be edited in pieces; tabs can be closed in bulk; the full script tree, engine scripts included, is available to the agent.
- Real-time DOM auto-fix, decided against the live DOM. Auto DOM for LSE.

### Editor stability and workflow
- Crash reporting moved to Sentry Native: minidumps, exception filters, one crash reporter per process. CrashRpt is removed.
- Fixed: the Blade freeze; organizer result dialogs blocking the message pump; a crash on deleting a null GUIXML; the RepoList repository callback dying before its answer arrived; Script Sync and folder handling; shutdown crashes from missing null checks; terrain shadows; the caret half-pixel rendering bias.
- Window resizing and Auto Window Scalable are implemented.
- World list: HideWorldListPopulation option, improved sorting, and a new wake-up overlay with live status updates. The Firestorm login screen was rebuilt.
- Update system: skip-version support and UI improvements.
- New HeroBlade debug console, client logging infrastructure, DX9 flow tracing, frame-timing tools, an engine frame meter and faster database access.
- Restricted evaluation mode is fully supported.
- Production builds no longer write development traces.

### Engine and third-party dependencies
- Boost was first upgraded to 1.90.0 and then removed entirely in favour of the C++ standard library (client and server).
- Granny updated from 2.9.7.0 to 2.118.0, with synthetic model generation for 2.11.8 assets and configurable diagnostics.
- PhysX upgraded from 2.8.4.2 to 2.8.4.6; NXU_string instance-level removal; cooking library thread-safety improvements.
- FMOD Studio integrated behind a wrapper that keeps FMOD Ex compatibility.
- zlib upgraded from 1.2.3 to 1.3.1; compression level raised to maximum and protected with HMAC; Oodle data protection enhanced with HeroProcess.
- SQLCipher upgraded to 4.13.0 with the matching SQLite amalgamation.
- libcrypto and libssl updated to OpenSSL 3; NVAPI updated; OpenGL extension headers updated; FreeType headers updated and the DLG logging library added; 7-Zip binary updated.
- Added: DiligentEngine SDK, Dear ImGui, ozz-animation, DirectXTex, Discord SDK.
- Removed: Bink video (RAD Game Tools), Umbra, Awesomium, Assimp headers, BugSlayer.
